Title: Source 3
Content: The photograph shows students at a civil rights demonstration in the `text(1960s)`.

`text(One)` of the students in the photograph is John Lewis, a leader in the movement for voting rights, who later became a member of the U.S. Congress. The following is a quotation from Congressman Lewis.
:box:The vote is precious. It’s almost sacred. It is the most powerful nonviolent instrument or tool that we have in a democratic society, and we must use it.
